about: One table welds the pre-rite kūkulu reading: rite-command.test.ts reads each row through kukuluHand (rite-kukulu.ts) and through riteKukulu itself with no terminal; tools/lares-container.test.mjs plants the same facts behind the shim's `pulama status` and reads its line. Unnamed facts read vessel standing, current false, admitted false, offer false, no sync. `lei`: true (a return left), "absent", "returns-spent", or null (no read answered). `admitted` and `offer` name the image of the head where one stands already (the tag's, else a kept image `lares-surface:rev-<head12>` carrying the head's revision label, as the rebuild re-tags it). `kept`: the tag holds an older revision and a kept image carries the head's; the shell reads admitted and offer against it, and the TS twin reads them as the reading hands them. `sync` carries what the rite's fast-forward reads (`syncPlan`'s input; the upstream reads `up`).
